data.name: Relight
data.detailed_description:
Relight’s primary moves include a slide, ledge vault, and boost mechanic that can be chained together to build insane amounts of speed. In addition, other hidden moves exist within the movement system to facilitate greater skill expression for more advanced players.

The game's lore, storytelling aspects, soundtrack, and sound design are still very much unfinished. However, one thing I know for sure is that the game is fun. While watching playtesters, I noticed that although the game might not be for everyone, for some people who try it, it clicks. Even in earlier builds with worse game feel and graphics people kept playing because of the mechanics.

In my own research, I haven’t really seen a game similar to what I’ve made. So even if things are a little janky and may not look the best, I can guarantee you’ll get a unique experience here that you can’t find anywhere else. So please give it a try :)

data.short_description: Relight is a momentum based 2D platformer with deep movement mechanics. Run, jump, slide and ledge vault across a desolate world and be the spark to relight a once great civilization.
